records.title: Setting up of MSDIs under Coal Subsidiaries
details:
a: has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) for setting up of Multi skill Development Institutes (MSDIs) in subsidiaries of CIL.
ii) MSDIs at other subsidiaries are at different stages of implementation.

records.title: DIGI YATRA APP
details: अभी इसके तहत कितने लोग इसको यूटिलाइज कर रहे है, उसका विवरण हमारे पास है। मैं उसका डेटा अलग से भेज दूंगा।
